video_title: Tobias shoe game so elite, Dylan had to borrow them on Media Day 👟 #spurs #dylanharper #tobiasharris

quotes.speaker: Dylan
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan and Tobias Harris discuss the Kobe 6 PE sneakers
quotes.excerpt: I seen them in his locker, I liked them, I asked like where them, he told me yeah.

text_blocks.speaker: Dylan
text_blocks.text: I walked in on media day, new teammate Tobias Harris obviously has a bunch of Kobe PEs. I seen them in his locker, I liked them, I asked like where them, he told me yeah.

text_blocks.speaker: Tobias Harris
text_blocks.text: He seen them in my locker and he was like, yo those are fire. He was like, can I wear them? I was like, yeah you got them. Hey, you want to take them.

quotes.social_post: Dylan and Tobias Harris are already bonding over sneakers at Spurs media day. Dylan says he liked the Kobe PEs in Tobias locker so much that he just asked to wear them.

quotes.speaker: Dylan
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan reflects on Tobias Harris's sneaker collection from his Detroit days
quotes.excerpt: When he was in Detroit, he used to wear a good amount of Kobes.
quotes.quote: When he was in Detroit, he used to wear a good amount of Kobes. I always wanted to text my agent and be like, tell him to send me a pair. But now he's here, I can just take it from the locker.
quotes.social_post: Dylan says he used to want to ask Tobias Harris for his sneakers back when Tobias was in Detroit. Now that they are teammates in San Antonio he can just take them from the locker.

quotes.speaker: Tobias Harris
quotes.summary_phrase: Tobias Harris on the tradition of wearing sneakers on media day
quotes.excerpt: This is the first day of school, you put your best outfit out and then you rock it.
quotes.quote: This is the first day of school, you put your best outfit out and then you rock it. Certain times I always think like sneakers on media day. Some guys wear stuff that they may not wear in a game, so it's a quick little flex if you got something good.
quotes.social_post: Tobias Harris says media day is like the first day of school for players. He treats it as a chance to rock sneakers he might not wear in a game as a quick little flex.

quotes.speaker: Dylan
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan on the social media reaction to his sneaker choice
quotes.excerpt: Not a lot of people know his shoes, but when the big media outlets post it.
quotes.quote: Not a lot of people know his shoes, but when the big media outlets post it, it's like a cool little unc and nephew thing. That's what I like to call it.
quotes.social_post: Dylan is enjoying the social media reaction to him wearing Tobias Harris sneakers calling their dynamic a cool little unc and nephew thing.

quotes.speaker: Tobias Harris
quotes.summary_phrase: Tobias Harris on the honor of teammates wearing his player editions
quotes.excerpt: My PEs, he wear them, it's an honor, you know, like creating something.
quotes.quote: My PEs, he wear them, it's an honor, you know, like creating something. I mean, just came in, worked hard every day, set the standard for us and his shoe game is elite. I look forward to playing with him and taking all his shoes.
quotes.social_post: Tobias Harris says it is an honor to have his teammate wearing his player edition sneakers. He says he looks forward to playing with Dylan and joked about him taking all his shoes.

quotes.speaker: Tobias Harris
quotes.summary_phrase: Tobias Harris hints at more exclusive sneakers in his collection
quotes.excerpt: I got a few others that I haven't even brought out the storage unit yet.
quotes.quote: I got a few others that I haven't even brought out the storage unit yet. So he took a good pair, but I got some better ones in the lab for sure.
quotes.social_post: Tobias Harris says he has even better sneakers in storage that he has not brought out yet. He says he has some better ones in the lab for sure.
